sales_hooks: Amazon $100B+ CapEx 2026 — the largest absolute spend of any hyperscaler; AWS is both a GPU cloud and a custom silicon buyer, meaning HBM flows through two separate procurement channels simultaneously.
Project Rainier (Trainium2, 400K+ chips) is dedicated to Anthropic — Anthropic's Claude models drive a discrete, predictable HBM demand stream that memory suppliers can forecast against.
Amazon Trainium/Inferentia custom chips source HBM directly (not via NVIDIA) — a rare direct hyperscaler-to-memory-supplier relationship. Ask how your customer tracks and grows this procurement path.
AWS is the #1 cloud by market share (~32%) — every AI workload migrating to cloud adds to AWS HBM pull even if running on NVIDIA GPUs.
